definition: UPS equipment that maintains electricity through interruptions. Do not infer a duration unless stated; battery backup may also qualify when an explicit battery reserve is described.
Battery reserves that maintain operations during loss of the primary electricity supply, including at solar-powered sites. Storage alone does not establish a backup function.
Fuel-based generation that supplies electricity when the primary supply fails. Excludes generators serving only as the normal supply.
Independent alternative grid or substation feeds that maintain electricity when the primary feed fails. Multiple feeds without an explicit continuity function are insufficient.
Renewable generation explicitly arranged to maintain operations during loss of the primary supply. Battery backup may also qualify when storage provides the reserve.
